purpose: Keep the original historical coverage audit truthful while allowing only explicitly source-pinned D10 candidate rows to be observed in a later inventory snapshot. This file does not select or ratify candidates.
rules: Historical fields exact_name_in_d1_d10=false and selected_in_inventory=false describe the audited 625-row snapshot; do not rewrite them when the live inventory grows.
A matching live candidate remains research-only: coordinate=null, coordinate_basis=UNPLACED, ratified_resident=false, proposal_status=pending-owner-review, status=SELECTED-RESEARCH-CANDIDATE.
Only transitions listed with the exact stable_id/source_class/provenance are tolerated. Any other current collision is a hard failure.
No D1-D9 collision, no duplicate selected name, no executable/T5 admission, no ratification.
